priority.description: Priority order when recommending Dialtone solutions

details.component: Always prefer Vue components when available (e.g., DtButton over custom button styling)
details.utility-class: Use utility classes for spacing, layout, and simple styling (e.g., d-pr2 for padding-right)
details.token: Use design tokens for custom implementations or when components/utilities don't exist

details.semantic: Prefer semantic color tokens (e.g., --dt-color-foreground-primary) over base colors
details.base: Use base color tokens (e.g., --dt-color-purple-400) only when semantic colors don't fit the use case

details.typography: Prefer typography utility classes (e.g., d-body--md-compact) or typography tokens (e.g., --dt-typography-body-md) for complete text styling
details.text-styles: Use individual text style tokens (e.g., --dt-font-size-200) only for fine-tuned control

search.description: How to search Dialtone documentation effectively
tips: Use specific technical terms rather than natural language
